Official postgame recap states that Saints RB CJ Donaldson left with a shoulder injury in the first half and S Justin Reid was ruled out with a concussion just before halftime. The recap does not provide exact game-clock boundaries or a complete printed injury/return sequence.

Official NFL final gamebook confirms PIT 16-NO 10; lists every starter, substitute, did-not-play and inactive player; records Aaron Rodgers and Tyler Shough as the sole participating quarterbacks; records Chris Boswell/Cameron Johnston/Christian Kuntz and Daniel Carlson/Ryan Wright/Zach Wood as participating specialists; and prints CJ Donaldson Questionable at Q2 15:00, then CJ Donaldson and Justin Reid Out at the Q3 7:32 timeout. The book does not print either player's original injury play or any return, so no earlier exit boundary or return is inferred.
